description: This file defines the interface for the rtMessage module, including functions for creating, cloning, serializing, deserializing, and manipulating message objects, as well as managing message fields of various types.

methods.name: rtMessage_Create
methods.description: Allocates storage and initializes it as a new message.

methods.name: rtMessage_Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the given message, copying only the data within its fields.

methods.name: rtMessage_FromBytes
methods.description: Initializes a message from a byte buffer.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToByteArray
methods.description: Extracts the message data as a byte array.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToByteArrayWithSize
methods.description: Extracts the message data as a byte array, allocating buffer based on suggested size.

methods.name: rtMessage_FreeByteArray
methods.description: Frees the byte buffer allocated by serialization functions.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetString
methods.description: Adds a string field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddString
methods.description: Adds a string to an array within the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddBinaryData
methods.description: Adds binary data to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddMessage
methods.description: Adds a sub-message to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetArrayLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of an array field in the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetStringItem
methods.description: Retrieves a string item from an array in the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetMessageItem
methods.description: Retrieves a message item from an array in the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetInt32
methods.description: Adds an integer field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetDouble
methods.description: Adds a double field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetMessage
methods.description: Adds a sub-message field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string field by name.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetBinaryData
methods.description: Retrieves binary data from a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value of a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetInt32
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value of a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double value of a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message field.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToString
methods.description: Formats the message as a string.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetSendTopic
methods.description: Gets the topic of the message to be sent.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetSendTopic
methods.description: Sets the topic of the message to be sent.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetBool
methods.description: Adds a boolean field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean field.

methods.name: rtMessage_Retain
methods.description: Increases the reference count of the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count and destroys the message if count reaches zero.
